# What a broker may send in one piece: five packets, one behind the other
20 02 00 00                 # CONNACK, accepted
90 03 00 01 00              # SUBACK to the packet identifier 1
30 1b 00 11 'display/gx/values' 'first' 80 00 ff    # PUBLISH: 27 = 2 + 17 + 8, the payload is five letters and three bytes
d0 00                       # PINGRESP
31 05 00 03 'a/b'           # PUBLISH, retained, on another topic and without payload: 5 = 2 + 3
